picks.name: Byrne Chelsea Boot, brown suede
picks.why: The brushed-brown Chelsea is still missing from the boot rotation, and this one is £120, down from £280 and under target, with UK 10 in stock. Matte calf suede, leather-lined, on a Vibram sole, so it handles wet days. Wear it with the 502s or the fawn chinos and a knit for the office.

picks.name: 100% Merino Crew Neck Jumper, navy
picks.why: The office outfit still has no knit, and this is the cheapest way to fill it properly: fine 100% merino, plain, no branding, sleeves that reach the wrist. Layer it over a tee with the fawn chinos and the brown suede Chelseas.

picks.name: 7006 Essential T-Shirt, norway spruce
picks.why: Tees are still the biggest gap, and every outfit starts with one. A washed organic-cotton crew in a deep green-grey that sits between olive and charcoal, with no logo, 30% off and L in stock. Wear it under the navy merino crew or the field jacket.
